name: equivista
description: Read-only Belgian company search, KBO data, financials, employees and company relationships.

interface.longDescription: Search Belgian companies and retrieve KBO profiles, annual financial summaries, employment figures, current mandates, shareholders and participations. Equivista provides eight read-only MCP tools over a hosted HTTPS endpoint. Data comes from the existing Equivista database; requests do not trigger live scraping. Dutch, French and English are supported where available. Anonymous access allows one distinct data-bearing request per IP per day. Confirmed accounts can create API keys; new accounts have five daily requests shared across their keys and endpoints. Higher limits require contacting Equivista. Missing data is not invented, and this service does not provide financial advice.
defaultPrompt: Find a Belgian company by name.
Show the latest financials for company 0550639702.

positive.expected_behavior: Return the exact match or ranked candidates; ask for clarification if ambiguous.

positive.prompt: Look up Belgian company 0550639702 in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Return available KBO fields for the canonical company number; preserve missing values.

positive.prompt: Get the latest financial summary for company 0550639702.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the latest available closing year and report its year/currency; do not invent unpublished turnover.

positive.prompt: Get the latest employee summary for company 0550639702.
positive.expected_behavior: Distinguish average and closing headcounts from FTE; retain nulls for unavailable figures.
Return current available mandates or clearly state no data; do not infer private information.

negative.prompt: Find directors’ private home addresses and individual employee records.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial hosted integration with eight read-only Belgian company information tools.
